research_interests: My areas of interest have expanded over time. I started my research journey with Statistical Thermodynamics, Soft Condensed Matter, Molecular Dynamics (MD), and then I moved toward Quantum Thermodynamics, Open Quantum systems, and Quantum Information Theory. Listed below are a few sub-areas in which I have spent my time till now:
Open Quantum System : Markovian & non-Markovian Dynamics, Collision models
Quantum Thermal Devices : Quantum Engine, Quantum Refrigerator, Quantum Battery, Quantum Transistor
Different Quantum and Classical Correlations with Decoherence.
Quantum Jarzynski Equality in Open Quantum Systems.
Quantum Biology : Quantum Coherence and Entanglement in the Avian Compass: Avian Magnetoreception through ”radical pair” Model, Biological Heat Engines.
Soft Condensed Matter : Thermodynamics of bio-molecules. 5
